cost_note.zh: 收入周基数的1.5倍；基数=年总收入快照/52，限制于100至1,000,000,000。
cost_note.en: 1.5 times the captured weekly base: annual gross income / 52, clamped to 100–1,000,000,000.

consequence_note.zh: 确认汗廷丈量方案；后续巡界取决于官署、牧场、土地法与地方安定，也会触动地主与牧户态度。
consequence_note.en: Choose the court survey; later patrols depend on offices, ranches, land law and local calm, and affect landed and rural interests.

consequence_note.zh: 由旗盟共管界址；后续要维持牧场与旗盟承诺，地主和牧户都有议价空间。
consequence_note.en: Let the banners manage boundaries; ranches and banner commitments must hold, with landed and rural interests sharing a voice.

cost_note.en: No treasury debit; require no default or bankruptcy, calm pasture disputes and continuing banner commitments.

consequence_note.zh: 沿用寺院调停；缓和争端但保留界权含混，后续有利教士并损及正式地主权威。
consequence_note.en: Use monastic mediation; calm the dispute while leaving boundaries ambiguous, favoring the devout over formal landed authority.

cost_note.zh: 收入周基数；基数=年总收入快照/52，限制于100至1,000,000,000。
cost_note.en: Captured weekly base: annual gross income / 52, clamped to 100–1,000,000,000.

consequence_note.zh: 拨款统一征调；后续须维持足够军额、官署、营房、军饷与武器市场供给，军方受益而地主不满。 军额按常备营计，至少 7 营，不包含当前动员的征召营；其他财政和供给要求仍须满足。
consequence_note.en: Fund central requisitions; sustain troops, offices, barracks, wages and the arms-market supply proxy, aiding the armed forces while alienating landlords. Army size means battalions: at least 7, excluding raised conscripts; all other fiscal and supply requirements remain.

cost_note.zh: 同一周基数的0.6倍，低收入时实付可低于100。
cost_note.en: 0.6 times the same weekly base; at low income, the fee can be below 100.

consequence_note.zh: 按旗分摊；后续军额要求较低，但仍核对军制、营房与武器供给，军方与乡村代表略获支持。 军额按常备营计，至少 5 营，不包含当前动员的征召营；其他财政和供给要求仍须满足。
consequence_note.en: Divide obligations by banner; require fewer troops while retaining army-law, barracks and arms-supply checks, modestly aiding military and rural interests. Army size means battalions: at least 5, excluding raised conscripts; all other fiscal and supply requirements remain.
